items.title: Mat Domber interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 12, 2007
items.q: Yank Lawson, and were playing, and that got me started with a whole new group of people.

ctx.x: No. Nothing like that. I never set out to build a jazz label or anything else, it just sort of happened. Then the other major thing that really happened to us was Rick was doing a

concert in St. Petersburg and for some reason or other the bass player who was supposed to be playing, this was about 1991 I would say, the bass player who was supposed to be playing with us couldn’t show up. So we were nervous about a bass player and somebody said to Rick there’s a guy by the name of Bob Haggart, who is a well known bass player, who lives in Venice, Florida. Why don’t you give him a call and see if he’d be interested. I thought to myself I knew about the Bob Crosby Band, I knew about the World’s…
Have you ever been to any of those jazz parties yourself?
